interpretation: Do not compare Procedural's CPU generation timings against Diffusion's GPU worker timings as a controlled speed ranking: different hardware, different workload (patch compositing vs. latent diffusion sampling).

Diffusion's per-accepted-pair cost varies 40x across defect types (7.7s thread_top to 103.3s thread_side), driven almost entirely by stage-1 mask yield, not by inpainting cost (see member_c_delivery.md SS9: lowering inpaint steps 200->50 saves only ~2s/pair).

The 2026-10-18 downstream per-seed subprocess timings (screw Procedural, Diffusion metal_nut/screw) are not measured with the same internal-timer definition as the 2026-10-17 entries (real_only, Procedural metal_nut); they are Slurm/subprocess wall time including bundle loading and shared-QC recheck, not the trainer's internal clock. Treat cross-row comparison with that scope difference in mind.

Procedural has no learned fitting stage; Diffusion's reported costs already include its fixed anomaly/mask model training (jobs 40227, 39986) only indirectly -- those are one-time, shared-across-all-formal-generation costs, not amortized per defect type in this ledger.
GAN remains not_run_quality_gate; no downstream cost comparison is possible or claimed for it.
Null values denote missing or inapplicable measurements, never free generation or a zero quality score.
